eligibility: be eighteen (18) years of age or older
be eligible to work in the country in which they reside
be a student or a beginner to open source software development
cannot_apply_if: You cannot apply if you are a resident of a United States embargoed country
You cannot apply if you ordinarily reside in a United States embargoed country
You cannot apply if otherwise prohibited by applicable export controls and sanctions programs
You cannot apply if you are an employee (including intern), contractor, officer, or director of: Google or its affiliates, or an Organization or any of its affiliates

You cannot apply if you are an immediate family member (including a parent, sibling, child, spouse, or life partner) of a Mentor or Organization Administrator with the same Organization or a member of the same household (whether related or not) as a Mentor or Organization Administrator with the same Organization
You cannot apply if you have previously participated as a GSoC Student or GSoC Contributor in Google Summer of Code two (2) or more times
prepare: accept the terms of the GSoC Contributor Agreement
submit a Project Proposal through the Program Website during the application period
typical_timing: January: Mentoring Organization applications open for OSS projects (application period is 2 weeks)
February: Google reviews all Mentoring Org applications (3 week period)
February: Accepted Mentoring Organizations announced publicly
March: Interested applicants reach out to Mentoring Orgs to discuss their project ideas (4 weeks)
March: Aspiring GSoC contributors apply and submit their project proposals to orgs (15 day period)
April: Mentors and Org Admins review all contributor applications and rank their selections
May: Google Admins review Org requests and resolve duplicative selections
May: Accepted GSoC contributors are announced
note: No upcoming application dates found on the page (next season may not be announced yet).
